Industry Domains

5 Industry Domains Life Sciences & Healthcare Advanced Manufacturing & Microelectronics Digital Economy & FinTech Smart City & Green Living Aerospace & Aviation Technology Others

Strategic Focus
Improving human health, longevity, and well-being through advanced medical technologies, biomedical sensing, and smart healthcare solutions.

Industries

  • BioMedical & BioTech
  • Medical Device & Optometry
  • BioPharma & Therapeutic
  • Smart Healthcare & GeronTech

  • FoodTech & Sustainable Agriculture

Strategic Focus
Driving industrial upgrading, hardware innovation, and supply chain resilience through next-generation manufacturing and semiconductor technologies.

Industries

  • Semiconductors & Microelectronics
  • New and Advanced Materials
  • Intelligent Manufacturing &  Robotics
  • Green Manufacturing
 

Strategic Focus
Accelerating digital transformation and financial innovation by leveraging next-generation information technologies and secure data networks.

Industries

  • FinTech & Digital Finance
  • Big Data & Analytics
  • Cybersecurity

Strategic Focus
Enhancing urban infrastructure, sustainability, and modern lifestyle experiences through green energy, spatial computing, and creative technologies.

Industries

  • Smart City & Urban Infrastructure
  • New Energy & Green Technology
  • Low-Altitude Economy & Future Mobility
  • Textile & Wearable Technology

Strategic Focus
Advancing aerospace, aviation, and space technologies to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability across air travel, cargo logistics, and space exploration.

Industries

  • Aerospace Systems
  • Satellite Technology & Applications
  • Space Exploration & Space Robotics
  • Aviation Logistics and Supply Chain
 
PolyU IFC 2026 welcomes innovative projects from any domain. If your project does not fall within the above-listed focused industry domains, please specify your project's domain on the document submission form.
Eligibility and Participants' Gains

Application Procedure

Step 1

Please read the Terms & Conditions before submitting the application.

Step 2

The Principal Applicant to complete the Document Submission Form on behalf of the team with the following materials by the submission deadline (Please refer to the form for the deadline of each region).

  1. Personal and contact information of the Principal Applicant and team member(s)
  2. A link to a pitching video (maximum 5 minutes) 
  3. Pitch deck (PPT or PDF format, not more than 15 slides)
  4. Completed Declaration Form for Principal Applicant and Team Members
  5. (If applicable) Company registration document showing shareholding details.
  6. (If applicable) copies of student ID/ graduation certificate/ staff card of all team members
  7. (If applicable) Declaration of use of PolyU knowledge/ innovations/ technologies

Step 3

Applications will then be reviewed based on the materials submitted. Shortlisted teams for each region will be notified 4-6 weeks before the respective regional final.

 

Notes

  • If the relevant project has won a top 4 award in any region of the PolyU International Future Challenge 2025 or 2026, it will not be eligible to participate.
  • There is no limitation on the number of members within a team.
  • Each individual can participate in no more than three teams but can only serve as the Principal Applicant (PA) for one team.
  • Teams may apply for multiple competition regions.
Awards

Benefits for Awardees

MTE Tuition Sponsorship

The Master of Technology Entrepreneurship (MTE) programme aims to equip students to transform innovative ideas into successful ventures and develop into future leaders in technology entrepreneurship. The curriculum integrates the three key areas of technology, innovation and entrepreneurship, laying a solid foundation for students to embark on their journey as technology entrepreneurs. 

The following award winners of PolyU IFC 2026 will be eligible for the tuition sponsorships:

  • Grand Final: One member of the Innovation Cup winning team will receive 100% tuition sponsorship for the MTE programme.
  • Regional Finals: One member of each Diamond Cup winning team will receive HK$100,000 tuition sponsorship for the MTE programme.
    • Recipients must meet the entry requirements of the MTE programme to receive the sponsorship. For more details of MTE programme, please refer to the programme webpage.

 

Amazon Web Services (AWS)

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally. Millions of customers — including startups, enterprises, and government agencies — use AWS to lower costs, become more agile, and innovate faster.

Winners of PolyU IFC 2026 will be eligible for the AWS Activate program, which provides startups with:

USD $4,500 to up to $100,000 in AWS credits to build and scale on the cloud

  • Access to AWS technical support and architectural guidance
  • AWS workshops and training resources
  • Exclusive startup community and networking opportunities
 


Qianhai Shenzhen-Hong Kong Youth Innovation and Entrepreneur Hub

Winning teams in the finals will have the opportunity to receive the following support:

  • Advance to the semifinals of the China Innovation & Entrepreneurship Competition - Qianhai, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan Competition. (5 spots in total)
  • Winning projects that meet the eligibility criteria will be given priority for landing at the E-Hub.
  • Opportunities to connect with the funding of E-hub and the Global Investor Network.
Judging Criteria

Judging Criteria for Diamond Cup, Gold Award, Silver Award, Bronze Award and Best Student Team Award:

  • Innovation and Technology Content - 25%
  • Commercial Feasibility - 25%
  • Benefits to Industry and Community - 20%
  • Development Prospect - 15%
  • Team Capability - 15%

Probity Requirements
To maintain openness, fairness and integrity of PolyU, the Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company should be aware of the following relevant clauses to fulfil the Probity Requirements:

(a) The Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company should observe the Prevention of Bribery Ordinance (“POBO”) (Cap. 201, Hong Kong Legislation) and prohibit its directors, employees, sub-contractors, agents and other personnel who are in any way involved in the project from offering, soliciting or accepting any advantages as defined in the POBO in relation to the project.

(b) The Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company is prohibited from offering any advantages, whether directly or indirectly through a third party, to PolyU’s members of the Council, committees and sub-committees, staff and advisors, while having dealings of any kind with PolyU.

(c) The Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company is required to comply with anti-bribery laws and regulations in foreign jurisdictions when conducting business overseas and/or set up legal entities in foreign locations to support local operations.

(d) The Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company must promptly declare and notify PolyU in writing of any potential or actual conflicts of interest as soon as they become aware of them. A conflict of interest includes, but is not limited to, situations where the private interests of the Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company or its personnel conflict with or compete with their role, duties, and impartiality under the Scheme.

(e) The Applicant and/or Team and/ or the Company is required to take all necessary measures (including by way of a code of conduct or contractual provisions) to ensure that its directors, employees, sub-contractors, agents and other personnel who are in any way involved in the project are aware of and comply with the requirements as set out in this provision.
